theme_context.theme: Light theme (Primary) with Organic & Earthy archetype
theme_context.vibe: Premium, trusted, clear, and operational. Blends Indian agriculture with high-end fintech SaaS precision.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento High Density Grid for Dashboards: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
spacing_and_layout.cards: Internal padding p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision. Use grid layout for internal card structures.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 transition-all duration-200 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 border border-border transition-all duration-200 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.interactive_rules: All buttons must have a subtle hover transform (-translate-y-px), clear focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2), and disabled states (opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed).

components.cards: bg-card border border-border/60 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300 rounded-xl
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog. Backdrop must be backdrop-blur-md bg-black/40. Modal surface bg-card rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-white/20.
components.dropdowns: Use Shadcn DropdownMenu. bg-popover rounded-xl shadow-lg border border-border/50. NEVER use transparent backgrounds.
components.inputs_and_forms: Use Shadcn Input/Select. rounded-lg border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary. Use clear labels (text-sm font-medium).
components.charts: Use Shadcn/Recharts. Tooltips must match theme (bg-card border-border shadow-lg). Maintain responsive height (min-h-[300px]).
components.tables: Dense rows for records. text-sm. border-b border-border/50. hover:bg-secondary/30 transition-colors.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers/topbar: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border/40.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle solid borders (border-border). Avoid heavy borders.
visual_enhancers.status_indicators: Red/Amber/Green dot indicators or soft badges (bg-green-100 text-green-800) for operational states (Harvesting, Transit, Pending).

motion.hover: Subtle translation (-translate-y-[1px]) for interactive cards and buttons.
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out, transition-transform duration-200 ease-in-out (DO NOT use transition-all).
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for dashboard cards using framer-motion or simple css animations.

profile_farmer.description: Elderly Indian farmer smiling, for profile avatar or hero section

marketplace_vegetables_1.description: Colorful fresh vegetables for marketplace inventory cards

marketplace_vegetables_2.description: Brinjals and cucumbers for specific listing examples

marketplace_vendor.description: Indian man at a market, showcasing tradition

instructions_to_main_agent: Transform the flat CRA design into a premium, operational SaaS dashboard for Indian agriculture.
IMPLEMENT a global CSS variable system in src/index.css using the provided HSL color tokens (no hsl() wrapper in the variables, just numbers).
ALL components (buttons, dropdowns, cards) must have interactive states (hover, focus, active).
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical or functional Bento-style grids.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Modals, Dropdowns, Datepickers) and ensure they are styled with the new theme.
Replace primitive prompt()/alert() calls with beautiful Shadcn Dialogs and Sonner Toasts.
Implement real Recharts for 'Market Prices' and 'Home Dashboard' using the defined chart color tokens.
Ensure 'My Produce' and 'Buyer Requests' use modular cards with clear visual hierarchy, status badges, and action buttons.
ALL interactive elements and key informational areas MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-produce-button').
Always apply optical alignment (e.g., button text and icons visually centered) and generous padding.
Add empty and loading states with soft muted colors and clear CTAs.
Use .js files (JSX), NOT .tsx files for all React components.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or sticky headers. Always use solid or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur + bg-opacity).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over primary buttons or alert colors meets APCA minimums (WCAG AA).
accessibility.focus: All actionable items must have focus-visible ring.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Use lucide-react for default icons. Prioritize pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Use sonner for toasts located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx (if available) or create a js equivalent.
